books.title: The Second Miracle: Intimacy, Spirituality, and Conscious Relationships
books.author: Richard Moss
books.description: Moss argues that spiritual maturity shows itself in our capacity for intimacy and conscious relationship. The book looks at deepening connection with oneself, with others and with life as a whole, at the ego's fear of losing itself, and at how the quality of our attention changes what is possible.

left_out: How Shall I Live?: Where Spiritual Healing and Conventional Medicine Meet (ASIN 0890874182, from the Amazon link on https://richardmoss.com/books/): his books page gives only the title and a used-copy link, with no description, and I found no other page I could read that says what the book contains, so it could not be described or checked against the health rule. Left out as unverified.
